1.1.0: FileId inputs changed from 'text' to 'filepicker'. Requires Appmixer 4.4.4 or higher.
1.2.2: Fixed encoding issue with UTF-8 files without BOM.
1.3.2: improve CSV2HTML, CSV2JSON and JSON2CSV, JSON2HTML converters to use streams.
JSON2HTML, CSV2HTML: added support for custom HTML renderers.
1.4.0: PDF2Text: new component to extract text from a PDF file.
1.4.1: Added check for valid XLSX file in XLSX2CSV component. Throwing early if the file is not a valid XLSX.
1.4.2: Output examples for all converters. PDF2Text's file name option reads filename, the key the saved file carries.
1.4.3: Security: upgraded xlsx (SheetJS) to 0.20.3, vendored as the official SheetJS tarball (prototype pollution and ReDoS when reading crafted files; npm has no fixed release).
1.4.4: Security: upgraded tar to 7.5.22 (path traversal, symlink poisoning and hardlink advisories), and moved archiver's transitive minimatch (3.1.5, 5.1.9) and brace-expansion (1.1.21, 2.1.7) to patched versions (ReDoS).
1.5.0: Security: moved minimatch to 11.0.1 (DoS via globparts amplification, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249). Upgraded archiver to 7.0.1 and unzipper to 0.12.5 so that no dependency still needs glob 7 (incompatible with minimatch 11); archiver-utils glob pinned to 14.0.2.

Replaced SheetJS (xlsx) with read-excel-file and write-excel-file for XLSX, node-html-parser for HTML tables and csv-stringify for CSV output in CSV2XLSX, JSON2XLSX, HTML2XLSX, HTML2CSV, HTML2JSON, XLSX2CSV, XLSX2JSON and XLSX2HTML. The vendored xlsx tarball is gone: the component uploader stores files as text, so it never installed. CSV2HTML, CSV2JSON, JSON2CSV and JSON2HTML are unchanged.

Output differences of the eight components above: XLSX2HTML and HTML2XLSX-produced HTML tables keep the same structure (every cell is a <td>, first row is the header, text is escaped) but carry no SheetJS data-t/data-v/id attributes. XLSX2CSV and HTML2CSV still start with a UTF-8 BOM. Values are typed as before (numeric and boolean text becomes numbers and booleans, blank header cells become __EMPTY, only the first sheet is read); dates read from a workbook are written as ISO 8601 strings. A JSON file that is not an array, an HTML file without a table and an invalid workbook fail with a clear error instead of a library crash. Input files are limited to 50 MB (CONVERTERS_MAX_FILE_SIZE in the module config).
E2E test flows for all 15 converters.
